scope: Bounded009 dual-history follow-up: same four frozen005 datasets, corrected sampler, architecture, seed, optimizer and5000-step budget. Each same sampled window gets separate50% recorded-history and50% actor-owned-history MSE losses; no simulator advances.

readiness_limits.interpretation: All six strict improvements required before independent runtime checks and consideration of a physical trial. Best prior per-scope thresholds; no closed-loop success claim.

selection: Keep the same six best-prior readiness thresholds. Report every500-step result and actual supervised-label coverage; no physical trial until fit and independent runtime checks pass.
sampling_contract: Uniform supervised-start index0..episode_length-32. Burn=min(start,64), beginning at max(0,start-64); real history only. Equal-history examples share groups, mean loss weights all supervised labels equally. True episode-start batch probability remains.5. All label indices reachable; finite random draws need not visit every nominal label.

command_history_contract.initial_reset: Audit actual episode starts; previous command must be zero.
command_history_contract.truncated_window_anchor: At observation_start>0, initialize previous command once from the actually recorded preceding command. This is the only recorded command used inside the window.
command_history_contract.warmup: Use only actual recorded sensor observations; all subsequent previous commands are model predictions. No gradient during warmup.
command_history_contract.scored: Every previous command comes from the model, including the first scored step after warmup; teacher force targets are never substituted.
command_history_contract.gradients: Detach action feedback at every step and hidden state at the end of warmup; retain GRU BPTT through all32 scored steps.
command_history_contract.fixed_state_limitation: Predicted actions do not affect recorded sensor measurements. This is offline autoregressive input rollout, never physically evaluated correction or closed-loop success.
command_history_contract.loss: 0.5*MSE(recorded-view,target)+0.5*MSE(actor-view,target), evaluated on identical label indices. Never average predictions before scoring; opposite errors cannot cancel.
command_history_contract.recorded_view: Actual recorded commands are teacher commands on nominal data and original student commands on correction sources. No new expert labels are generated.
command_history_contract.regularization_limitation: Actor-owned substituted commands may be inconsistent with captured accelerations/contact states; this is offline history robustness regularization, not newly physically feasible experience.

evaluation: Keep all original six fit criteria unchanged. Additionally report recorded-history and actor-owned-history predictions continuously across every complete source, with one reset per source and no reset at chunks. Extra diagnostics do not replace any original gate.
